blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local stocks fell to their lowest level since April 2020 on Friday as investors sold index heavyweights, led by port operator International Container Terminal Services Inc. (ICTSI). The benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) dropped 3.12 percent, or 170.93 points, to close at 5,306.98, its weakest finish in more than six years. […]...
